notes: «وساق أبو كريب الحديث بقصته نحو حديث ابن نمير» refers to another route of the story; no chain of ابن نمير is written here, so he is not a link of this report
«عن أبيه» is Hisham's father, named only by relation: relation
«قالت سحر» and «قالت قلت» are Aisha's words within the saying; the Prophet is not a link
